snippet.title: Brew & Dash Trailer
snippet.description:
Jump, duck, accelerate, brake to test your reflexes, dodging obstacles and enemies, collecting ingredients along the way to brew potions, gain new powers, and go even further. Face challenges on randomly selected maps.

Demo Available on Steam!
